[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Rigosso''' was a [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] henchman who worked for the ruler of [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]], [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]].

==Biography==
In [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], Rigosso and a team of six [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] were hired by the leader of [[Quarzite]], [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]]. Their objective was to protect Blank's unwilling bride, the [[Kage/Legends|Kage]] [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|Pluma Sodi]] as she was trapped in a chest. The fight between the bounty hunters and [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] resulted in over half the hunters being thrown from the train. Blank's loyal henchman, Rigosso, teamed up with what was left of the hunters. The Kage people were suffering an increasing number of casualties, and the battle for Pluma seemed in favor for the decreased number of just two hunters and the loyal Major Rigosso.

Pluma's [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|brother]], who was the leader of Kage warriors, boarded the [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] as it approached [[Otua Blank's stronghold/Legends|Otua Blank's fortress]]. Rigosso was the first to confront Krismo Sodi as he boarded Blank's subtram. Sodi and Rigosso both exchanged words, and Rigosso taunted Sodi into a fight. Sodi threw his blade into Rigosso's chest, killing the [[Belugan]]. Sodi recovered his blade and continued to his sister, rescuing her with the help of one of the bounty hunters, [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. The subtram continued to its destination, but Blank found [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] in the chest instead of his bride.

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Over my dead body!|Rigosso's last words|<ref name="Bounty" />}}
Major Rigosso was loyal to his leader, [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]] and therefore accompanied his leader's cargo to protect it from the Kage Warriors. He was also loyal enough to tell the Kage Warrior's leader that if he wanted the cargo they'd have to kill him to get to it (which the leader complied to in short order).

==Behind the scenes==
Rigosso made his first appearance during the [[Bounty (episode)|20th episode]] of the fourth season of [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]] and was voiced by [[Tom Kane]].
